# Native recursor computation controls

The authored IotaGate.lean uses Tutorial.Meta from Arena Beta commit
60654ab87757ee8b07e3a292fc546f18e8131a27 (Apache-2.0). The native
NDJSON exports were generated by Lean PR release 16595-cb63311.
See the exact qualification artifact 15173687615 for official
kernel verdicts, source pin, and A/B run. Mutations change rule
metadata on the actual Boolean export. These files are fixtures
only; runtime code has no input-name or digest-based dispatch.
